tip: Use tänder for lights, candles and fire; devices like a TV take sätter på instead. Han tänder lampan.
Start a sentence with an adverb and the verb stays in second place, so the subject follows it. Först då förstod jag.
The particle ut turns räkna (count) into räkna ut, to work something out or calculate it. Vi räknar ut svaret.
The particle in fylla i means fill in a form; the i is stressed and never drops. Jag fyller i formuläret.
Dressing verbs take a reflexive: ta av sig means take off your own clothes, so sig is required. Han tar av sig skorna.
Paired comparison uses ju ... desto: the more of one, the more of the other. Ju mer du övar, desto mer självsäker blir du.
